integrity: The theorem has an analytic proof based on the exact unchanged-time Hamiltonian transformation and Gaussian-tail estimates. Bounded algebraic and quadrature checks corroborate but do not prove the infinite limit. Best-of-knowledge literature comparison records residual priority risks.
scientific_limitations: Fixed a in R, kappa>0, E->infinity. No uniform original-coordinate limit at transition phases, no joint parameter limits, no convergence rates or monotonicity theorem.
title: Universal logarithmic frequency and square-wave limit at a cubic global center
